name: Metricool
description: Metricool is a social media management platform for planning, publishing, analytics, reporting, advertising, and inbox workflows.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned Metricool API token and bind it to one exact numeric user and brand, then let agents inspect bounded identity-redacted brand references and connected network types.

credentialRequirements.name: METRICOOL_USER_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Metricool user token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the token from Account Settings > API on an Advanced or Custom plan. Relay encrypts it and sends it only as X-Mc-Auth to https://app.metricool.com.

credentialRequirements.name: METRICOOL_USER_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Metricool user ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Paste the exact numeric userId documented by Metricool for the customer account.

credentialRequirements.name: METRICOOL_BLOG_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Metricool brand ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Paste one exact numeric blogId for the brand this Relay connection may inspect.

capabilities.label: Read brand structure
capabilities.description: Read bounded identity-redacted brand references and connected network types for one exact Metricool user and brand.

approvalRequired.label: List Metricool brand references
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five numeric brand IDs without names, URLs, owners, collaborators, or connected-account identity.

approvalRequired.label: List connected network types
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five network type keys and connection booleans for the exact bound brand without profile identity or content.

blocked.label: Access private identity or social content
blocked.description: Brand names, URLs, owners, collaborators, profile IDs, handles, messages, posts, media, comments, and other social content are outside Relay's bounded connector.

blocked.label: Access broader analytics, ads, or competitors
blocked.description: Analytics, reports, advertising, competitors, hashtags, SmartLinks, and performance dashboards remain blocked.

blocked.label: Publish, use inbox, or administer Metricool
blocked.description: Drafting, scheduling, publishing, editing, deleting, replying, moderation, connections, users, teams, billing, webhooks, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, methods, queries, bodies, pagination, bulk operations, exports, browser sessions, and undocumented endpoints remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both bounded identity-redacted reads require approval; all identity, content, analytics, advertising, competitors, inbox, publishing, writes, raw API, pagination, bulk, and export surfaces remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same two bounded reads run directly; exact user/brand binding, fixed GET paths, identity redaction, response caps, audits, and Relay's local request ceiling remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives two bounded Metricool read tools with exact user/brand binding and identity redaction.
Hermes receives the same two bounded Metricool read tools with exact user/brand binding and identity redaction.

providerSetup.blocker: Metricool API access requires an Advanced or Custom plan plus a customer-owned API token, exact numeric userId and one exact numeric blogId.
providerSetup.nextAction: The customer copies the token from Account Settings > API, supplies the exact user and brand IDs, and completes a live read-only connection check.

evidence.supports: Metricool documents customer API access for Advanced and Custom plans, a token copied from Account Settings > API, and use for data export and task automation.
Official API documentation fixes the base at https://app.metricool.com/api and requires X-Mc-Auth userToken, userId and blogId on calls.
Official OpenAPI documents GET /admin/simpleProfiles for account brands and GET /admin/blog/profiles for the bound brand's profile summary.
Metricool confirms X-Mc-Auth plus userId/blogId, identifies simpleProfiles as the brand-discovery endpoint, and permits custom-header HTTP integrations.

securityNotes: The customer token is encrypted as a secret reference and is sent only in X-Mc-Auth to the fixed https://app.metricool.com origin.
Every request is bound server-side to the stored numeric userId and one exact numeric blogId; tools accept no alternate IDs, paths, methods, queries, or bodies.
Responses are capped at 1 MB and twenty-five items; redirects, arbitrary pagination, raw responses, and exports are blocked.
Brand names, URLs, owners, collaborators, profile IDs, handles, messages, posts, media, comments, and other identity or content fields are excluded.
Analytics, reports, advertising, competitors, SmartLinks, inbox, scheduling, publishing, connections, users, teams, billing, webhooks, and all writes remain blocked.
Relay enforces a conservative local ceiling of sixty Metricool requests per minute in addition to provider controls.
